apps.name: WavRemote
apps.subtitle: Control your Wavlink mesh Wi-Fi.
apps.localizedDescription: See every device on your Wavlink mesh, block or speed-limit them, change Wi-Fi names and passwords, share Wi-Fi with a QR code, switch guest and kids' Wi-Fi, check your mesh points and restart the router. Works away from home through a VPN to your home network.

versions.localizedDescription: Add WavRemote for iOS with a SideStore source

apps.versionDescription: Add WavRemote for iOS with a SideStore source

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: WavRemote talks to your Wavlink router on your home network.
